common.call937: Call the Ministry of Health on 937

error.title: We could not finish that
error.body: Make sure you are connected to the internet, then try again. Nothing you finished will be lost.
error.bodyStart: Your answers are still here, so you can try again.

offline.banner: You are offline. The check keeps running on this phone.
offline.startBlocked: Starting the check needs an internet connection. Connect, then try again.
offline.savedLater: We will save your results when you are back online.

denied.title: Camera access is off
denied.body: Azm needs the camera to see how you move. The video stays on your phone. It is never recorded or sent.
denied.ios: In Safari, open the page menu next to the address, then Website Settings, then Camera, and choose Allow. Or open Settings, then Safari, then Camera. Then come back here and tap “Try again”.
denied.android: In Chrome, tap the View site information icon next to the address, then Permissions, and turn on Camera. Then come back here and tap “Try again”.
denied.other: Open your browser settings for this site and allow the camera. Then come back here and tap “Try again”.
denied.samsung: In Samsung Internet, tap the lock icon in the address bar, then Site permissions, and allow the camera. Then come back here and tap “Try again”.
denied.askHelp: Ask someone to help you with this step.

none.title: No camera found
none.body: Use a phone with a front camera, and open the check on it.

busy.title: The camera is in use
busy.body: Close any other app that uses the camera, then try again.

stopped.title: The camera stopped
stopped.body: The screen may have locked, or you switched to another app. We will start this try again from the beginning.

camera.later: I will do the check later
camera.motionOff: Motion access is off, so we cannot check that the phone is level. Please make sure it stands upright and level.

first.body: Set your starting point in about {minutesFrom} to {minutesTo} {unit}, then check again every {weeks} weeks to follow how your movement changes.

due.title: Your check is due
due.body: Check again to compare your movement today with your starting point.

entry.error: We could not load your check details. Make sure you are connected to the internet, then try again.

repeatOffer.body: You can check again over the next few days, between {from} and {to}.

upcoming.early: Do the check now, before it is due

locked.title: Today’s check is postponed
locked.cleared: My doctor or care team told me physical activity is fine for me

entry.endedEarly: Today’s check ended early. The results of what you finished are kept.

blocked.title: The movement check is not available yet
blocked.body: The movement check opens when your program is ready. See your medical condition answers to find out what is needed.

leanRepeat.title: A more accurate starting point for the side lean

entry.homeSoon: The movement check will show here when it opens at home.

resume.notice: Before we continue, we will ask a few short questions again about how you are now.

afterIntake.title: Do you want to set your starting point now?
afterIntake.body: A check of your movement with your phone camera, about {minutesFrom} to {minutesTo} {unit}. You can also do it later from Today.

desktop.title: The movement check works best on a phone
desktop.body: You will stand the phone upright {metersFrom} to {metersTo} meters from you. Scan the code with your phone to open the check there.
desktop.qrAlt: QR code that opens the movement check on your phone

guest.title: Try the movement check
guest.notSaved: This is a trial and nothing is saved. The video stays on this phone.
guest.offlineNoModel: Movement tracking cannot be prepared without an internet connection this time. Connect, then try again.

position.ask: Which of these fits you best?
position.hint: Everyone does the arm tests sitting down.

support.ask: Is one side of your body weaker than the other?

pain.ask: Do you have ongoing pain in any of these areas?

restrictions.ask: Do any of these apply to you?

staff.titleBooth: Our team is here at the booth
staff.titleHome: We will not run the movement check for you for now
staff.bodyHome: For your safety, with your medical condition we only run this check under supervision. Talk with your doctor or care team about the physical activity that suits you.

guest.keepBody: Create a free account, then set your starting point at home and check again every {weeks} weeks to see how your movement changes.
guest.scan: Scan the code with your own phone
guest.qrAlt: QR code that opens the Azm sign up page
guest.fullCheck: The full check, in about {minutesFrom} to {minutesTo} {unit}

boothOnly.title: For now, the movement check is available only at the Azm booth
boothOnly.body: You can see an example of the results page, or watch a demo.
boothOnly.bodyDemo: You can watch a demo of Azm.
boothOnly.example: See an example of the results

adult.title: The movement check is for adults
adult.body: The movement check is for people aged {age} or older. Thank you for your interest in Azm.

position.standing: I can stand and get up from a chair
position.bed: I spend most of the day in bed, or I cannot sit without someone supporting me

support.right: Yes, my right side is weaker
support.left: Yes, my left side is weaker
support.none: No, both sides are about the same

condition.sci_unsure: Spinal cord injury, I do not know which type
condition.upper_limb_unilateral: Loss of all or part of one arm
condition.lower_limb_unilateral: Loss of all or part of one leg

restriction.no_overhead: I need to avoid lifting my arms above shoulder height
restriction.no_resistance: I need to avoid weights and resistance
restriction.no_weight_bearing: I need to avoid putting weight on my legs
restriction.balance_support: I need support to keep my balance
restriction.no_exercise: My doctor told me not to exercise for now

consent.title: Before we keep your results
consent.body: To show how your movement changes over time, we need to keep your check results in your account.
consent.pointVideo: The video stays on your phone. It is never recorded or sent. We keep numbers only.
consent.pointWithdraw: You can withdraw your consent at any time from Your medical condition.
consent.privacyLink: Read how we use your data
consent.required: Tick the consent box to continue.
consent.withdraw: Withdraw your consent to keep movement check results
consent.withdrawConfirm: After you withdraw, we will not keep new checks. Your earlier checks stay until you ask us to delete them.

context.title: Is this still right?
context.body: We use it to choose the tests that suit you.

intro.illustrationAlt: A person sitting on a chair, with a phone standing about two meters in front of them.
intro.howToStop: If you want to stop during a test, sit down if you are standing, lower your arms, then tap Stop on the screen.

need.heading: What you need today
need.chairSteady: A steady chair with a back
need.chairArmrests: A steady chair with no wheels and no swivel, with armrests on both sides, for the side lean
need.chairArmless: A steady chair without armrests, for the arm bends
need.chairStand: A firm chair about knee height against a wall, with something sturdy in front such as a kitchen counter, for the chair stands
need.wheelchair: Your wheelchair with the brakes on, and its side guards for the side lean
need.phone: A place where the phone can stand steady at chest height, such as a shelf, or books against a wall
need.space: About three big steps of space between you and the phone
need.helper: Another adult beside you for these tests: {tests}
need.loadFirst: Something light to hold for the arm bends, such as a closed water bottle, or nothing
need.loadSame: The same weight or bottle you used last time
need.shoes: The same shoes at every check, or bare feet every time

soundCheck.title: Let’s make sure you can hear the sound

exit.title: Leave the check now?
exit.bodyBefore: Your answers will not be kept.
exit.bodyDuring: Results of the tests you finished are kept.
exit.bodyGuest: Nothing is saved in this trial.

precheck.title: A few questions first
precheck.howToAnswer: Answer each question as you feel right now.

areas.hint: You can choose more than one area.
areas.rate: How much does it hurt right now, from {min} to {max}?

checklist.hint: Go through each item on the list.

precheck.listenEarphones: Listen to the list with the earphones

helper.askToRead: Ask your helper to read this.
helper.noWeakerSide: If neither side is weaker, stand on their left.
helper.altStand: Top view. The chair is against a wall. The phone is halfway between straight ahead of the person and their stronger side. The support is in front, away from the phone side. The helper is beside the weaker side, slightly behind.
helper.altTrunk: Top view. The phone is in front of the seated person. The helper is beside the weaker side, slightly behind.

plan.title: Your tests today
plan.meta: About {minutesFrom} to {minutesTo} {unit}. You can skip any test.
plan.noneTitle: We will not run any test today
plan.noneBody: Every test was skipped today for the reasons shown. You can try again on another day.

variantWhy.booth: At the booth, everyone does this test without a weight.
variantWhy.painArm: No weight, because you told us about pain in this arm.
variantWhy.noResistance: No weight, because you told us you need to avoid weights.
variantWhy.safety: No weight today, for your safety.
variantWhy.handsAllowed: You may use your hands in this test.

test.answerBooth: Say your answer from where you are. A staff member will tap it for you.

shoulder_abduction.chair: A person on a chair raising a straight arm out to the side, thumb up, with the phone two to three meters in front.
shoulder_abduction.wheelchair: A person in a wheelchair raising a straight arm out to the side, thumb up, with the phone two to three meters in front.

arm_curl_30s.chair: A person on an armless chair bending the elbow {load}, side on to the phone, one and a half to two meters away.
arm_curl_30s.wheelchair: A person in a wheelchair bending the elbow {load}, side on to the phone, one and a half to two meters away.

trunk_control_seated.chair: A person on a chair with armrests leaning a little to one side, with the phone about two meters in front.
trunk_control_seated.wheelchair: A person in a wheelchair leaning a little to one side, side guards in place, with the phone about two meters in front.

chair_stand_30s.standard: A person standing up from a chair set against a wall, arms crossed on the chest, with a sturdy support in front and the phone at an angle between straight ahead and the stronger side.
chair_stand_30s.arms_assisted: A person standing up from a chair set against a wall, pushing on the armrests, with a sturdy support in front and the phone at an angle between straight ahead and the stronger side.
chair_stand_30s.one_arm_cross: A person standing up from a chair set against a wall, one hand on the opposite shoulder, with a sturdy support in front and the phone at an angle between straight ahead and the stronger side.

test.stopBooth: To stop at any time, say “Stop” to a member of our team, or touch Stop on the screen.
test.placeBooth: The phone is already in place. Sit in the marked chair, and we start when we can see you.
test.placeBoothWheelchair: Stay in your wheelchair at the mark.

skip.title: Skip this test?
skip.body: That is fine. This test will have no result today.

load.bottleHint: Use the same bottle every time, filled to the same line and closed.
load.armOnly: You will do this test with this arm without a weight.
load.sameTitle: Do you have the same one as last time?
load.sameYes: Yes, I have the same one
load.newLine: Today this arm will not be compared with its starting point, because the weight is different.
load.practiceRestLoad: Rest what you are holding on your lap, then answer.

primer.title: Let’s turn on the camera
primer.body: Azm sees your movement through your phone camera. The video stays on your phone. It is never recorded or sent.

postpone.title: Let’s postpone today’s check
postpone.sciAgain: Done, go through the list again

issue.motion: We need motion access for the phone

setup.helperOk: We can see someone beside you. That is fine.
setup.stillNoOne: We still cannot see you. Make sure the front camera faces you.
setup.viewDiagramAlt: Top view showing where the phone goes relative to you

stillness.body: It is fine if staying still is hard. You can skip this test today.

hud.tapForSound: Tap to turn on the sound
hud.sideChangeWheelchair: Turn your chair, or move the phone to your other side.

fix.paused: Someone else was in the picture
fix.touched: Someone touched you during the try
fix.out_of_frame: Part of you left the picture
fix.not_visible_arm: We could not see your arm clearly
fix.not_visible: We could not see you clearly
fix.plane: Raise it out to the side

retry.touchedHelper: We ask your helper not to touch you during the test, unless you lose your balance.
retry.lowFpsBody: Close other apps, then try again.
retry.after2min: We will try again after two minutes of rest.

safety.adCard: What to do for autonomic dysreflexia

ad.title: Stop the check and sit upright

safety.kept: Results of the tests you finished are kept.
safety.keptGuest: Nothing is saved in this trial.
safety.boothStaff: Our team is close by at the booth.
safety.adJump: Go to the steps for autonomic dysreflexia

stop.stayPut: Take your time. Do not get up to come to the phone if you feel dizzy or unsteady.

stopDone.title: That is fine
stopDone.next: Go on to the next test

checkin.settingNote: We pause a test and ask if you leave the picture or stop moving.

skipNotice.painTitle: Today we skip the tests that use the area that hurts
skipNotice.handsTitle: You needed your hands, which is fine

count.note: We will show this count without comparing it with your starting point.

results.keepProgram: Carry on with your program as usual.
results.endedEarlyBody: These are the results of what you finished.
results.noneMeasured: We could not measure any test today. You can check again on another day.
results.notReached: We did not reach this test today.

booth.title: Booth staff mode
booth.wrong: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
booth.on: Booth mode is on for this phone.
booth.offlineReady: This phone is ready to work offline.
booth.offlinePreparing: Getting this phone ready to work offline
booth.resetConfirm: We will clear these results for the next visitor.
booth.idleBody: These results will be cleared in {s} {unit} for the next visitor.
booth.badgeHint: Staff can press and hold here to start again for a new visitor.
booth.closed: Booth mode works only on booth days and during booth hours.
booth.limited: Too many tries. Wait a little, then try again.

settings.title: Staff settings
settings.note: They apply on this phone in booth mode only. Visitors do not see them.
settings.testsNote: Turn a test off if it does not work well here. It then does not appear in the visitor’s tests.
settings.planeNote: A lift counts when the upper arm shows at least {fallback} of its reference length, in place of {standard}. The rule is saved with each result.
settings.readout: Staff readout during the arm raise
settings.readoutNote: Shows the upper arm ratio, the side lift check, quality issues and frames per second on the screen. None of it is saved.

tips.title: Setup tips
tips.light: Have the light in front of you, not behind you.
tips.sleeves: Fitted or folded sleeves help the camera see your elbows.
tips.background: A plain background behind you helps the camera.
tips.height: Place the phone upright and level, at about chest height.
tips.distance: Move {metersFrom} to {metersTo} meters from the phone, about three big steps, so your whole body shows.
tips.people: Your helper may be in the picture beside you, but not between you and the phone.
tips.wheelchair: If you use a wheelchair, place the phone a little lower and a little further back, and keep your lap clear.
tips.boothStand: For the booth team, before each chair stand
